items.title: 被 Mandy 迷住的 GTA 6 玩家显然包括任天堂前总裁
items.summary: A character named Mandy has the attention of many Grand Theft Auto 6 players--and that appears to include Regg

content.v: A character named Mandy has the attention of many Grand Theft Auto 6 players--and that appears to include Reggie Fils-Aimé, the man who used to run Nintendo of America.

Per GamesRadar , former Nintendo marketing and public relations manager Krysta Yang joked on social media that GTA 6, which is front-loaded with a lot of simulation-like busywork in the first chapter, is "adult Animal Crossing," posting images that highlight parallels between GTA 6 and Animal Crossing: New Horizons. Fils-Aimé quoted the post, saying: "If so, where's Mandy?"

It's slightly eyebrow raising that the former executive for a family-friendly company like Nintendo seems to have a strong opinion for a rather promiscuous video game character. No judgment to Fils-Aimé, of course, but talk around Mandy carries a certain... tone. Minor spoilers for the early parts of GTA 6 follow.

One of the earliest missions in GTA 6 has Jason stopping by Mandy's home to collect rent. Long story short, she flirts pretty aggressively with Jason, who clearly isn't reciprocating, and Mandy doesn't take it well. And no, even if players wanted to, you can't romance Mandy .
It doesn't help that it's implied that Mandy carries a dark secret , with Jason discovering a severed finger while fixing her sink's pipes. I'm not sure if anyone in Animal Crossing is that shady.

So what does this post say about Reggie Fils-Aimé as a person? It's unclear what he thinks of the character--all we know is that he'd really like to know who the Animal Crossing equivalent of Mandy would be. It certainly wouldn't be Isabelle, so take your pick of any weird villagers you've encountered. Either way, it seems that Fils-Aimé is playing GTA 6 like the rest of us or, at the very least, is in tune with the massive cultural zeitgeist the game has produced.

items.title: 在 GTA 6 中扮演曼迪的演员在角色走红后兴奋地吐露心声
items.summary: Lexie Shoaibi, the actor who plays Mandy in GTA 6, is speaking out now that the game has been officially relea

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/20/mandy-actress-speaks-out-gta6-1795216516675.jpg
Lexie Shoaibi, the actor who plays Mandy in GTA 6, is speaking out now that the game has been officially released worldwide.

GTA 6 is finally here, and players have wasted no time looking up the actors behind some of its colorful cast of characters. As the days go on, more and more performers are revealing that they played a part in the game — and one of these is going particularly viral due to a mystery surrounding their character.

The actor who plays Mandy, a character players encounter early in the game, identified herself as Lexie Shoaibi, an American model and actress based out of New York. She posted the news on her Instagram account on November 19, where she revealed that she provided both Mandy’s voice and motion capture.

“She’s a lot of fun, so if you play the game, let me know if you find me,” she said. In another post , Shoabi thanked Rockstar for casting her in the game, writing, “Y’all there aren’t words!!!! Thank you so much for the love and support. This is crazy!! Ily forever!”
Warning: Spoilers for GTA 6 ahead. Turn back now if you want to remain unspoiled!

Mandy is a character who’s been put under the microscope due to a few odd details that players noticed in her home. If you’ve played the first few hours of the game, you’ll know that Jason gets called over to collect rent from Mandy, who says she won’t pay up until her sink is unclogged. Jason finds the source of the clog — all while fending off aggressive romantic advances from Mandy — which appears to be a human fingerbone. Mandy snatches it from Jason’s hand and runs off with it before he can get a good look at what it really is.

A quick stroll through her home and backyard show even more disturbing bits, such as a body-sized hole in the back garden and tubs of acid. The trunk of her car has also been packed with tools that could feasibly be used to kidnap or kill a victim. With all this in mind, fans are convinced that Mandy is actually a serial killer who seduces her victims. (Jason’s loyalty to Lucia really paid off!)
Commenters were quick to praise Shoabi for her performance as Mandy and joke about her uncomfortable, one-sided crush on Jason, with one joking, “Why’d you do that to a committed man?”
“BRO. You had me in a chokehold, but I have to stay loyal to Lucia. Sorry Mandy!!” another said.
“Mandy listen… Look, I know we got off on the wrong foot, ok? Give me another chance,” another wrote.

If the serial killer theory is true, it means she might not be the only murderer around; fans also spotted references to Dexter in the game, prompting even more curiosity as to Mandy’s true intentions.

items.title: GTA 6 迎来康卡斯特历史上最繁忙的一天
items.summary: Comcast has said GTA 6's launch triggered the busiest traffic day the company has seen since it was founded in

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/19/early-weapons1-1795092418085.jpg
Comcast has said GTA 6 's launch triggered the busiest traffic day the company has seen since it was founded in 1963.

The latest record broken by Rockstar Games' latest actually comes from one of the biggest media and technology companies in the United States. After previously reporting that Grand Theft Auto had led to a 4x increase in traffic on Xbox consoles November 18, Comcast has now confirmed that pre-loads for the day resulted in the busiest day it has ever seen – and it wasn't close.

Comcast recorded peak traffic 31% higher than the average day and 9.6% higher than the previous record holder. Moreover, GTA 6 has resulted in five out of 10 of the busiest days the network has ever seen. Even more remarkable is the news that, as reported by Comcast, 24% of all of its internet traffic during peak times was from users downloading and playing the game.

If Rockstar fans weren't playing GTA 6, they were watching it. Twitch traffic increased by almost 50% on November 18 and is continuing to rise in the days following that launch. GTA 6 launched for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S November 19, but thanks to the New Zealand trick , a massive chunk of players actually took their trip to Leonida hours early. It certainly helped boost traffic across the board, and in Comcast's case, it resulted in its busiest day ever.

To put some of these numbers into perspective, the company shared a very relevant measurement. November 18 traffic generated on PlayStation and Xbox alone delivered enough data for one million homes to stream The Odyssey in 4K… for two days straight.

It's shocking to see how GTA 6 affected Comcast, but then again, we've known Rockstar's new game would be a juggernaut when it eventually launched. The developer's parent company, Take-Two Interactive, reported that it had earned an unbelievable $3.79 billion in the first day after its release. That makes it not just the biggest video game launch of all time, but the biggest entertainment launch across any medium .

Critics everywhere helped GTA 6 earn the title of highest-rated game of all time . IGN was included in that list after delivering a 10/10 review . We said, "Exquisitely detailed, endlessly ripe for experimentation, and uncompromisingly engineered, Grand Theft Auto 6 is the single most impressive video game I have ever played."

items.title: 尽管GTA 6的地图很大，但乘坐飞机飞过它只需要大约4分钟
items.summary: Someone had to do it.

content.v: GTA 6's map is so big it's going to take months for people to comb through it and find everything. Rockstar has already posted the full map of Leonida online, but it doesn't answer one simple question that I know we've all been wondering: How long would it take to fly across this entire thing in a plane?

The answer is a lot less time than it would take to go by car, but still long enough to give you an idea of the sheer scale we're working with here. Using the closest plane to Jason's house, my trip across Leonida took around 4 minutes and 18 seconds , which is a little under an hour of in-game time. You can watch the entire flight from start to finish below.

Keep in mind that the Mammoth Dodo seaplane that carried me from the southern tip of the archipelago to the northern tip of the map is just one type of plane in GTA 6. I would bet there are faster options if you really want to zoom.

Even though I'm still very early in the GTA 6's story, I didn't have to go too far out of my way to test this. Jason's house is conveniently located pretty close to a spot with perfectly unattended planes to borrow. The Sunbelt Highway that runs south of it will lead you right to the earliest planes and helicopters you can find . Just don't fly over the nearby military base (trust me, it's bad news) and you'll be fine.
I learned a few things on the way:

Rockstar compared GTA 6's map to its previous games , describing it as about the size of GTA 4, GTA 5, and Red Dead Redemption 2 combined. Despite knowing this beforehand, I was still shocked to see how the map kept going when I first opened it up. Four minutes might not sound like a lot, but the enormity of it all sinks in as you glide above densely populated cities and neighborhoods that could be the setting of their own standalone videogames.

My experiment has left the fog of war on my map split into two halves. My flight path carved a line of partially revealed locations straight through it. I don't expect to clear the rest out for dozens of hours, but now I'm tempted to find out how long of a roadtrip it would be to do the same journey by car.

items.title: GTA 6 独家商店关门迎接非终极版买家后，玩家的反应
items.summary: GTA 6 players are being locked out of in-game stores because they don't own the Ultimate Edition, and they've

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/18/g-blog-12-1794995262221.jpg
GTA 6 players are being locked out of in-game stores because they don't own the Ultimate Edition, and they've got some thoughts about how Rockstar handled it.

We've known for months that the developer's latest sprawling open-world video game would have a $79.99 Standard Edition and $99.99 Ultimate Edition to pick up at launch. Those willing to pay the $20 upcharge netted a solid assortment of cosmetics, weapons, vehicles, and unique shops, leaving those who didn't shell out the extra cash with fewer options to choose from when taking Jason and Lucia out into Vice City.

Rockstar has been clear about what this would mean for standard owners , but in practice, players are feeling like the door has been (literally) closed in their faces. GTA 6's exclusive in-game shops – One-Eyed Willie's, Sara's Unisex Salon, Stock 305, and Electric Fang Tattoo Parlor – are the topic of conversation here. Not everyone was sure how exactly these stores would bar players from entry upon release. It seems, at least based on the consensus from disappointed players, they were expecting to at least be able to enter the locations and not buy anything – but Rockstar doesn't even give them that.
GTA 6's Ultimate Edition grants you access to a few stores across Leonida, so what happens when you try to enter them in the Standard Edition? #gta6 https://t.co/GMaHpdLwnc

We broke down the Standard vs. Ultimate Edition contents with a side-by-side video that you can check out above. As you can see, the shops have fully decorated interiors that are completely closed off to those who didn't pick up the more expensive version of GTA 6. Those who spent the extra dough can go about their days shopping as they please, while those who didn't have found an unwelcome surprise when heading to any of these spots in Leonida.

Being physically locked out of the building is maybe a bit more brutal than some were expecting, but it's the reality players are meeting – and they aren't happy. Comments from disgruntled fans online have called Rockstar's move to keep content blocked off "greedy" and "shady," with many upset that a relatively substantial amount of finished content is only accessible by spending more money. Others are disappointed to see that there wasn't a cheaper compromise, such as making exclusive shops a late-game unlock. Either way, it's the door in the face that seems to sting the most.
"I'm all for companies making money - but when you pull the kinda money rockstar is - this just feels greedy/shady," one player said .
@IGN https://t.co/BWg2G4TQHk
"Paid $80 just to get bounced from a store like I'm under 21," another replied .
"So the Ultimate Edition just locks the door in your face?" another player reacted . "That's the most expensive closed sign I've ever seen."

GTA 6 launched for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S November 19. Whether you decided to pick up those extra cosmetic options or not, Rockstar seems to be quite pleased with the release. Earlier today, it noted that it had secured the biggest entertainment launch in history with $3.79 billion in just 24 hours . IGN gave the game a 10/10 review .

items.title: 佛罗里达小丑如愿以偿：他是侠盗猎车手6中的“特别配音演员”
items.summary: Looks like Lawrence Sullivan settled his differences with Rockstar.

content.v: Remember in the closing days of 2023, when Rockstar dropped the first trailer for Grand Theft Auto 6 ? Amidst the everything it had going on was a brief shot of a man with extensive facial tattoos, who was quickly called out by people hip to such things as a knockoff of Florida Joker, aka Lawrence Sullivan, a Florida man who went viral for his 2017 mug shot .

Sullivan himself called it out in a since-deleted TikTok video, first telling Rockstar " we gotta talk " and then, with no response forthcoming, threatening legal action . Not long after that, though, he put forth a new offer: " Let me voice the character , give me more storyline in the game… Let's make history happen, man."
It seems that Sullivan got what he wanted: In a video posted to Instagram, Sullivan said he was given a role in GTA 6.

"I'm an official voice actor on GTA 6, the game." Sullivan says. "For the last three years a lot of people were saying I was not going to be in the game, I was not going to be nothing, they were destroying my mental health. They were saying a lot of fucked shit. But now it's time for me to shit on them and show them what the fuck Florida Joker is about!"
"Y'all gonna see. Special voice actor for GTA 6. This ain't no gimmick, this ain't no lie!"
A post shared by Florida joker 🃏 (@floridaajoker)
A photo posted by

I had doubts, but this apparently really ain't no gimmick or lie. Rockstar has posted the full GTA 6 credits and sure enough, Lawrence Sullivan is in there. Now, it could be a different Lawrence Sullivan, sure, but under the circumstances I don't think that's very likely.

Sullivan's role doesn't appear to be a particularly prominent one: He's credited, along with a great many other people, as one of "The Local Population." But at the end of the day, he made it: Florida Joker really is in GTA 6, and he seems pretty chuffed about it. I'd call that a happy ending.

items.title: 试试这个 GTA 6 移动速度设置，让杰森和露西亚走得更快
items.summary: Pep up their step.

content.v: If you want to move faster in Grand Theft Auto 6, I can't blame you: There's a lot I've enjoyed about the opening hours I've spent in Jason's shoes. He's handy with a nailgun. He's a good sport when I make him wear the dumbest graphic tees I can find. For a gunslinging drug runner, he's a gentle soul. I just have one complaint.

The man's got a leisurely gait. Which is fine! But there are plenty of times while roaming Leonida when you might wish he and Lucia were moving just a bit faster—just not so fast that you want to force them into a run. Luckily, Rockstar's got our back: There's a setting to bump up your basic movement speed without pushing a button.
How to increase your movement speed in GTA 6
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/rQNzX6dGiDY9JgXbwC2DFM-1920-80.jpg
To change the pace that Jason and Lucia move at in GTA 6, head to Settings , move over to the Gameplay tab, and scroll down to the Movement section. The setting you're looking for is Movement Speed .

This doesn't affect your top speed while sprinting and burning stamina. What it adjusts is the speed you move at when you fully push the joystick. There are four options, each one offering more speed than the last: Walk (the default), Fast Walk, Jog, and Run.

It's a nice bit of granularity. I go with Fast Walk to give just a slight bump in my base speed without feeling like I'm rushing, but Jog or Run are good options if you really want to cover ground. Whichever one you choose, you can still voluntarily move at a slower pace by only slightly tilting the joystick.

There's also a Combat Movement Speed setting, which—as you might expect—changes the pace you walk at in a gunfight. There are only three options here: Fast Walk, Jog, and Run, because nobody wants to move slowly when they're actively being shot at.

While you're in the menus, I'd recommend digging around to inspect all the available options. Rockstar included a lot of toggles and tweaks for fine-tuning how GTA 6 handles. You can even turn off vehicle damage altogether, if you don't want to pay for car repairs. Not that I've ever crashed or anything. Don't ask my mechanic.

items.title: 五条悟的英语配音演员没有意识到他为 GTA 6 录制的这些狂野台词
items.summary: Kaiji Tang, the English voice actor behind iconic anime characters like Jujutsu Kaisen’s Satoru Gojo and Demon

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/20/satoru-gojo-voice-actor-gta6-1795209301743.jpg

Kaiji Tang, the English voice actor behind iconic anime characters like Jujutsu Kaisen’s Satoru Gojo and Demon Slayer’s Sanemi Shinazugawa, was left stunned after learning that he had unknowingly recorded lines for GTA 6.

It seems like some of GTA 6 ’s cast are just now learning that they were featured in the game, as evidenced by a few posts circling online a day after its official global release. One of these cast members is prominent voice actor Kaiji Tang, known for providing the English voice for several main characters in popular series like The Apothecary Diaries , Kengan Ashura, and Baki , just to name a few.

In the early morning hours of November 19, Tang posted on X/Twitter confirming he was in Rockstar’s highly anticipated crime-sim. However, he revealed that he wasn’t aware the lines he recorded were going to be used in this particular game, leading to a hilarious interaction with a fan.
“I had no idea what I recorded was for this game,” he wrote. “Imagine my shock.”
“Considering they had you saying, ‘Sit on daddy’s lap,’ I’m curious what you thought it was for,” a fan replied.
“I dunno, Demon Slayer?” Tang answered.
i had no idea what i recorded was for this game imagine my shock lol
@actualcannibal i dunno demon slayer?

Tang is a major figure in the voice acting business with an extensive portfolio under his belt, so it’s no surprise to learn that he lent his talents to GTA 6. Aleks Le, another popular voice actor in anime and video games, revealed that he also contributed to the project, and even said that he asked the directors for permission to include one of his famous lines from Street Fighter 6 — though it’s still unclear if that particular phrase made it into the final product.
Tang isn’t the only actor just now learning they’re in GTA 6; athlete, author, and influencer ‘Jessishiking’ revealed that they were also just now made aware of their involvement in the game.

In a celebratory post on Facebook, Jess revealed that they played the GTA series’ first-ever nonbinary character (which, to avoid spoilers, we won’t name here). They said that they were required to sign several NDAs and had no idea what they were filming for at the time due to the extreme secrecy around the game.

“Absolutely wild to find out THIS was the super-secret game I spent weeks and 17 NDAs filming 3 years ago,” they wrote in their post. “Some fun facts: GTA was one of the most inclusive and caring sets I’ve ever been on. I shot this back in my they/them days, and everyone on production ensured I was comfortable and gendered correctly. At the time I wasn’t allowed to know what I was shooting — I didn’t get confirmation until TODAY that it was, indeed, GTA 6.”

While the game’s full credits have since been revealed, it’s highly possible that we see more posts like this in the coming days from voice actors and performers excitedly learning that the secret project they recorded lines for many years ago is the biggest entertainment product of all time.

content.v: Actor Michael C. Hall has reacted to how GTA 6 features references to his Miami-set TV show Dexter, in which he famously played the serial killer Dexter.

Appearing on the Barstool Movies show, Hall said he was "informed" of the Easter eggs in GTA 6 about his character. "I wasn't consulted," he said with a laugh. "It's pretty cool to feel like [Dexter] has folded into the zeitgeist."

After the GTA 6 Extended Look premiered in August, people immediately spotted what they thought was Dexter's apartment building from the TV show . Now that GTA 6 has arrived, people found the apartment building in the game, and you can, too, by following GameSpot's Dexter apartment guide here .
On the TV show, Dexter dismembers his victims, stuffs them into garbage bags, and dumps them into the nearby harbor on his boat, the Slice of Life.

Players can also get into a kill house that bears a resemblance to the one that Dexter uses on the show, complete with plastic sheets for the blood splatter, hammers, and cleavers. Players have also found bones underwater, presumably another reference to Dexter.
GTA 6 is full of Easter eggs, so be sure to check out GameSpot's breakdown of GTA 6's best Easter eggs to seek out while you're traveling around Vice City.

items.title: 性感红 (Sexyy Red) 与杰森 (Jason) 的 GTA 6 瞬间获得最佳反响
items.summary: Rapper Sexyy Red has given a hilarious response to her cameo in GTA 6 after a clip of famous streamer IShowSpe

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/20/sexyyred-cameo-gta6-1795205750675.jpg
Rapper Sexyy Red has given a hilarious response to her cameo in GTA 6 after a clip of famous streamer IShowSpeed playing the game went viral.
Warning: Spoilers for GTA 6 ahead! Turn back now if you want to remain unspoiled!

Sexyy Red is one of several real-life music artists who have cameos in GTA 6 . Players come across her on a mission playing as Jason, who escorts the rapper into the VYB nightclub in Vice City after getting hired as a security guard. Eventually, Jason gets wrangled into dancing with her onstage, but he quickly backs out after getting a text from Lucia, who is also on a job at the club.

IShowSpeed, one of the internet’s most popular personalities, played through this part of the game during a livestream on YouTube and was stunned after Lucia texted Jason asking, “What are you doing?” Needless to say, Speed was shocked by how quickly Lucia was seemingly able to figure out what Jason was up to.
The moment went viral on social media and was even spotted by the rapper herself, who replied with a hilarious tweet: “We was just chillin’ mane.”
We was just chillin mane

Jason and Lucia’s romantic relationship is a central part of GTA 6, so it’s no surprise that Jason was a bit antsy about dancing with another gal. In fact, it’s one of the main reasons why players can’t hire prostitutes in this game.

Rockstar explained this change in a statement earlier this month, saying, “GTA 6 is a game about a couple in a bind, lovers on the run. While we have taken a lot forward from previous GTA titles, everything we have implemented in 6 has been done to support the spirit of the story we wanted to tell… Many aspects of previous titles are not present in GTA 6, but the elements we have we believe are all necessary and complementary to the feeling and motivations we wanted to emphasize as you play through Jason and Lucia's story.”

Aside from her cameo in GTA 6, Sexyy Red is an avid gamer; in October, she called out NetEase over Storm’s Legendary skins (or lack thereof) in Marvel Rivals , asking the developer in a pointed tweet, “When y’all gon give Storm her legendary skin?”

As previously mentioned, Sexyy Red is just one of several actual artists in GTA 6. Pinkpantheress hosts her own radio show in the game, as does Lana Del Ray, Bad Bunny, Freddie Gibbs, and even Kodak Black. The official soundtrack also features a slew of licensed and original songs from high-profile artists like Cardi B, Tame Impala, and many more.

items.title: 21% 的 Rockstar 员工已在公司工作超过 10 年，这在很大程度上解释了 GTA 6 破纪录的发布
items.summary: It's easier to make successful games when you hold onto the people who know how.

content.v: If we're using Metacritic as a metric, Grand Theft Auto 6 is currently the best-reviewed game of all time . Between preorders and launch-day sales, it's already made over $3.7 billion in sales revenue. It's being lauded as a landmark achievement in game design, storytelling, and engineering. So how, exactly, did Rockstar pull it off?

Well, the billion-dollar production budget certainly helped. But a Bloomberg report offers an important insight into how GTA 6 was able to deliver on its promises: According to a spokesperson, 21% of Rockstar's staff—roughly 1,000 people—have been employed by the company for over 10 years. For many of its development leads and directors, that figure is closer to 20 years, or higher.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Wq64uRf6b7bSqqUsy6zRjb-1920-80.jpg

By retaining its employees for so long, Rockstar is able to capitalize on the kind of shared, institutional knowledge and honed creative process that developers build through years of collaboration. We've seen that same kind of continuity at other studios who've delivered some of the last decade's biggest hits: FromSoft director Hidetaka Miyazaki has attributed its wins with Elden Ring and Armored Core 6 to its developers growing with the studio , while the breakout sales successes of Baldur's Gate 3 and Helldivers 2 were delivered by developers who'd spent years sharpening their craft at Larian and Arrowhead.

That lesson—that making successful games is easier when you keep the people who know how to make games around—isn't one that the games industry at large has been adhering to: In its latest game developer survey , GDC reported that 34% of its respondents had been laid off in the last two years. 20% of laid-off respondents said they'd been laid off twice or more in 24 months.

From Halo to Dragon Age , we've seen how beloved game franchises can suffer when their studios endure employment turmoil. After it laid off 1,600 Xbox workers in July, Microsoft's own employees said that myopic job cuts at major game companies were weakening the games industry as a whole by dismantling its ability to produce quality games.
It's a bell we've been ringing a lot around here.

Still, while Rockstar boasts a deep roster of veteran employees, those devs aren't confident that they won't be the next ones suffering from mass layoffs: We've seen plenty of successful launches lead to job cuts in recent years. As the company enjoys GTA 6's record-breaking launch, fears like those are why over 1,600 Rockstar employees in the UK are currently voting on unionization .

items.title: GTA 6 创下更多记录
items.summary: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 has finally arrived, and, to the surprise of no one, it's putting up some big nu

content.v: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 has finally arrived, and, to the surprise of no one, it's putting up some big numbers that speak to the pent-up demand. GTA 6 sold more than 30 million copies and hit almost $4 billion on day one , but that's just the start of understanding the impact of the game's release.

For starters, the internet service provider Comcast announced that November 18--the final day of preloading--was the busiest day in the company's history in terms of demand. Peak traffic was 31% higher than an average day and a full 9.6% higher that the previous biggest day ever for traffic to Comcast's network.

GTA 6 also now holds five of the top 10 busiest days of Comcast's network of all time. Going further, Comcast said around 24% of all internet traffic on Comcast's network was people downloading or playing GTA 6 on November 18 (no doubt thanks to the New Zealand trick ). Additionally, traffic to Twitch on Comcast's network was up by almost 50% and "is still increasing," Comcast said.

A spokesperson for Comcast further contextualized the traffic data, telling GameSpot that between when preloading began on November 10 and through November 18, PlayStation and Xbox traffic pushed enough data on the network for one million homes to stream The Odyssey in 4K repeatedly for two days straight.
Comcast was among the internet service providers that offered free speed boosts to subscribers to help them download GTA 6 faster.

Additionally, Mat Piscatella of Circana shared data that speaks to the enormity of GTA 6's launch on PlayStation and Xbox. For active accounts November 19 in the US, 61% of PS5 accounts "engaged with" GTA 6. On Xbox, 56% of Xbox players globally did. PS5 players averaged 513 minutes of play for GTA 6 on November 19, compared to 494 on Xbox.

These daily active user and minutes played figures are "absolutely bonkers," Piscatella said. GTA 6 was No. 1 on November 19, pushing Fortnite down to No. 2 based on these engagement metrics, Circana said.

For more, check out GameSpot’s GTA 6 review and our rundown of the five best things to do first. And if you’re eager for news on GTA 7 ? Get comfortable, because Rockstar is not going to announce it anytime soon .

items.title: GTA 6 是有史以来规模最大的娱乐发行项目，首日票房达 37.9 亿美元
items.summary: Rockstar Games has confirmed GTA 6 retail sales reached $3.79 billion in its first 24 hours, securing its plac

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/17/gta-6-soundtrack-1789662158949.jpg
Rockstar Games has confirmed GTA 6 retail sales reached $3.79 billion in its first 24 hours, securing its place as the biggest entertainment launch of all time.
Parent company Take-Two Interactive announced the news today. Rockstar founder and president Sam Houser shared his feelings about the landmark achievement in a statement.

"It is with immense gratitude that we enter a new chapter of Rockstar Games with the release of Grand Theft Auto VI," he said. "We are incredibly humbled by the response from players around the world and we couldn’t be more excited to share this moment with you."

After quickly emerging as the highest-rated video game of all time , breaking records across streaming sites , and causing wild spikes in internet traffic , we all kind of knew this was coming. After 13 years, Rockstar has pulled off the greatest score anyone has ever seen. Even in this new update, Take-Two said it was "proud" to help GTA 6 adopt its new crown.

Earning $3.79 billion in 24 hours is unheard of across any medium, meaning Rockstar's new Grand Theft Auto game didn't just stomp on launch sales for games like Red Dead Redemption 2, Cyberpunk 2077, or any Call of Duty game; it crushed any blockbuster movie release ever, too. It's still got a ways to go before claiming any titles like 'best all-time sales,' but it's a start better than anyone has ever seen in the history of gaming.

Just yesterday, it was reported that GTA 6 had managed to sell more than 20 million pre-order copies . Courtesy of Take-Two today, we now know that, somehow, these already staggering numbers actually significantly undershot the reality. The company has now confirmed that it actually moved 32.5 million pre-sale units alone. That's more copies than the vast majority of games have ever sold. Meanwhile, how many non-pre-ordered copies have been sold after launch is unclear.
GTA 6 launched for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S November 19. If this news is anything to go by, Rockstar is just getting started. IGN gave the game a 10/10.

items.title: Etsy 卖家正在关闭商店以响应该平台新的人工智能培训政策
items.summary: The platform says the new AI training policy is aimed solely at improving storefronts and tools, but not every

content.v: Online marketplace Etsy is facing backlash from users over a recent change to its policies that allow it and other companies to use content created by sellers to train AI models. In response, numerous vendors have closed their online shops, and are encouraging others to do the same. Etsy, however, says the new policy isn't meant to "replace your creativity," but simply to improve storefront operations.
The offending bit is found in part 5, section C of Etsy's terms of use , effective as of December 16:

You agree not to assert any moral rights or rights of publicity against us for using Your Content. You also recognise our legitimate interest in using it, in accordance with the scope of this license, to the extent Your Content contains any personal information. This also includes the right for us and our third party partners and vendors to use Your Content to develop, train, test and improve artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies, including to improve the Services and/or help keep them safe, subject to any applicable opt-out rights described in our Privacy Policy.

That seems pretty straightforward—anything you put on your Etsy page can be fed into the AI theft machine like Steve Buscemi in a Cohen Brothers film—and as reported by Cartoon Brew , it led to significant pushback from some Etsy users, including numerous store closures.
You might have heard of Etsy's new terms and artists fleeing the platform. We're out, too.
Ring Cats Etsy final closure notice
A post shared by Aaron Millard (@aaronmillardillustration)
A photo posted by

In the wake of that reaction, Etsy vice president of customer operations James Ossman posted a separate update saying it's not really like that at all, and that "we do not use your content to train AI models designed to copy your original work or replace your creativity."

"When we describe how we may use your content, we're enabling actions like translating your listing descriptions so buyers around the world can discover your items, or featuring your listing photos in Etsy marketing campaigns to showcase your creative work," Ossman wrote. "We also use your content to develop tools that make running your shop easier, like listing optimization tools or stats summaries that help you better understand your shop's performance. As always, your needs and feedback help guide how we build and improve these tools."

As for providing third-party access to that content, Ossman said that too is for "services and tools that can help you run your business," and promised that "when we partner with third parties, we do so thoughtfully to help protect your content and data."

That hasn't satisfied everyone. Ossman's commitment doesn't exist within the actual terms of service, which as seen above states only that Etsy and partners can "use Your Content to develop, train, test and improve artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies." Ossman also noted in his update that the terms "prohibit scraping Etsy or unauthorized use of content from Etsy to train AI models," but that (as far as I can tell) applies to Etsy users and unauthorized third-parties, not Etsy itself or those it licenses.

That's not to suggest that Etsy is being underhanded, merely that the binding legal language is imprecise. Others also complain that AI training should be opt-in rather than on by default—and worse, there's apparently no opt-out option available at all, so users who are opposed to having their work used for AI training for any reason are out of luck.

Ironically, the blowup over Etsy's embrace of AI training comes just weeks after it earned plaudits for banning AI-generated recipes and patterns, a move Ossman said was necessary to establish "trust" in the platform : "Sellers need clear guidance and confidence that their creativity and craftsmanship will be represented fairly; buyers need to understand what they’re buying and the human involvement behind it."

However this ultimately shakes out, the Etsy AI backlash is emblematic of a growing problem on both sides of the buy-sell divide: People want refuge from the creeping tendrils of the AI behemoth, and overtly or insidiously it's becoming increasingly difficult to find one. The more that happens, the more people are likely to react forcefully when platforms like Etsy start edging in the direction, regardless of any promises (or even carved-in-legal-stone commitments) of good intentions.
I've reached out to Etsy to ask if the new AI policy might be changed in response to the complaints and closures, and will update if I receive a reply.

items.title: 侠盗猎车手 6 中 99 个令人难以置信的小细节
items.summary: From gameplay quirks to secrets and Easter eggs, here are 99 incredible little details in Grand Theft Auto 6.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/20/details-blog-1795190382176.jpg

Grand Theft Auto 6 is here, and we’re finally getting to see what Rockstar has been cooking up for the last decade-and-change. It may be a studio already famous for its unbridled attention to detail, but just how many more tiny flourishes, references, and opportunities for emergent hilarity has Rockstar stuffed into GTA 6? The answer is a lot, so let’s get straight to it: here are 99 incredible little details in Grand Theft Auto 6. And don’t worry, you’ll find no story spoilers here.

1. From the get-go, it appears Rockstar has left no box unchecked. That is, during the Prologue, there’s a strong chance you’ll be successfully captured by the VCPD before you can effect a getaway. However, if you do manage to escape, you’ll get an extra segment of gameplay after the prison counselor addresses your initial evasion, in which she may even name-check the vehicle you used.

2. GTA 6’s selection of radio stations and podcasts is fabulous, and massively stocked with songs. Want to hear them when you’re outside of a car? You can purchase earbuds at an electronics store so that you can tune in via your phone.

3. Blood stains remain in the world for multiple days, so you may well receive a reminder of some poor behaviour on your part, even after sleeping and returning to the same spot in the days that follow.

4. Gang hideouts will reveal themselves all over the map as you progress, but one of the first you’ll probably find is an illegal animal smuggling operation tucked away in Jason’s hometown. Make sure you listen to the parrot for a clue to find more loot.
5. Speaking of animals, keep in mind that dogs will protect their owners, so consider that before you insult anyone out walking their best friend.
6. It’s also common to come across animals fighting amongst themselves, but if you spook them, they’ll typically scarper.
7. And no, it doesn’t appear that crocodiles take much interest in unconscious people that you may dump near them. But when they wake up, all bets are off.
8. The highly impressive blood tech will realistically coat surfaces the claret touches, such as covering a croc’s snout after snacking on an unfortunate fellow’s head.
9. Don’t park your car too close to the basketball hoop outside Jason’s first house. Even a well-placed shot could smash the windows of your ride.
Vehicles

10. Of course, cars can suffer considerably more than a busted windscreen, and car damage in GTA 6 is ludicrously good. Panels buckle dramatically, parts fall off, and dents appear exactly where they should.
11. Lose a wheel and the unfortunate rotor scraping against the asphalt will glow bright red as it dramatically heats up.

12. There’s a distinct difference in paint quality between hasty Pay ’n’ Spray jobs and professional recoats at a dedicated auto shop. Pay ’n’ Sprays offer extremely limited colours, and the paint finish has a noticeable “orange peel” effect.
13. Car glass isn’t perfect and, in the right light, you can see lots of scuffs, scratches, and imperfections.
14. Wipers will even leave visible streaks on the glass during rain, even though that’s something you’d only ever see rarely in the first-person view.

15. Businesses have their own vehicles, and you’ll spot vans and trucks across the map with all kinds of corporate and small business logos plastered on them. We’re still seeing ones we haven’t noticed, even after 120 hours, and it greatly increases the feeling of vehicle variety on the road.
16. The details on cars even extend to the fact that they have animated drivetrains – you can more easily spot when you flip a car, so take this as an excuse to get a little chaotic.
17. Some cars even have under-door lighting – an incredibly subtle effect you may well only occasionally see at night.
18. Brakes glow as a result of heavy use.
19. Superchargers make a very distinct noise, and your engine will sound different once you install them.
20. Vehicles have functioning indicators and windows, and you may even spot NPCs rolling up their windows if you’re annoying them. To use your own blinkers, tap left and right on the D-pad.
21. Truck nuts on vehicles. That’s it. No, they don’t shrink in the cold, but I’m not holding that against it.

22. Alongside the massive number of regular vehicles to discover, there are many unique vehicles sporting huge, custom decorations to find. One is a bright pink fan for a seafood restaurant that has “Our Shrimp so Pimp” painted on it.

23. There are also much, much cooler examples, including a very, very familiar Fast and Furious-adjacent green sports car with a custom paint job, tucked away in the largest house on Vespucci Island. The plate is the perfect touch, too: HAD YOU.
24. Like the cars, boats have also been lavished with attention to detail, and are typically christened with their own individual names, just like in real life.
25. And on that note, boats can now be physically launched from boat trailers, retrieved from the water again, and towed to anywhere else on the map. Same goes for jet skis and kayaks.

26. Cars and motorcycles can also be manually loaded onto trailers and towed anywhere you want. It doesn’t get around the tracker system, so it isn’t a method to cheat the new security features, but it’s still fun to fool around with.
27. Not only are jumbo jets way, way more authentically scaled – seriously, they’re huge now – but you need to enter them physically and walk to the cockpit to fly them.

28. Hijacking an enormous commercial airliner isn’t a thing the authorities will ignore or quickly forget. Soon after takeoff, you’ll be flanked by a pair of fighter jets who’ll order you to land, and shoot you down if you don’t. Jumbos are tougher than ever and will survive direct strikes from smaller aircraft, like choppers, but maybe it’s best to follow their orders.
29. Seriously, if you can see it, there’s a pretty good chance you can use it or drive it. This includes mundane work equipment like scissor lifts…
30. Excavators with huge claws…
31. Forklifts (which, unlike in GTA 5, are now strong enough to lift cars)...
32. And mobility scooters. They’re not quick (obviously), but if you’d thought, surely we can’t drive those ; think again.

33. We haven’t found a go-kart at this point, but here’s hoping something eventually unlocks at the as-yet unopened go-kart track, Hot Skidz, located next to the Frontier mini golf course near Belville.
Items, Animations, and Discovery
34. The out-of-order arcade cabinets you’ll spot around the world all seem to have different notes and warning signs indicating they’re busted; it’s not just a single repeated texture.
35. Not all arcade cabinets are out-of-order, though; be sure to check out GTA 6’s cheeky take on Buck Hunter in Jason’s local bar.

36. Early in the game, the band performing at The Rusty Anchor plays unique covers of songs that don’t feature on GTA 6’s radio stations, including songs direct from the original GTA: Vice City. We won’t spoil which ones, but listen up when you encounter them.
37. The cane burning taking place at one of the map’s farms is a great visual, and just one of dozens and dozens of authentic little environmental surprises and flourishes going on around the map.

items.title: 暗影之心博德之门 3 前传小说揭晓
items.summary: The next Baldur's Gate 3 prequel novel has been revealed, focusing on Shadowheart.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/20/shadowheart-book-bg3-announced-ign-1795194442338.png
Shadowheart is the next Baldur's Gate 3 character to get a prequel novel after "Astarion" by T. Kingfisher released earlier this year .
Published by Penguin Random House , Baldur's Gate 3: Shadowheart, written by Tasha Suri, is already available for preorder at major retailers like Amazon. It will launch next year on June 8, 2027.
Here's the official blurb:
"A calculating priestess must investigate a brutal murder in this darkly fantasy from the World Fantasy Award winning author of the Burning Kingdoms trilogy.
Shar's blessings upon you.
Her name is Shadowheart. As a devotee of the dark goddess Shar, she knows little more about herself than this. But she does know faith and power, and what it takes to keep them.
In the end, all else is detail.

Beneath the bustling city of Baldur’s Gate and within the secretive, underground church she calls home, one’s past is a weakness best sacrificed to the fathomless Mirror of Loss. With oblivion comes strength, but without the bonds of memory, treachery festers among even the most ardent of Shar’s acolytes.

"When a member of their order is killed in the Upper City, Shadowheart and her so-called allies are called to investigate. She trusts none of them: not Mirie, the ambitious Griefguard; not Caldan, the cynical propagandist; and certainly not Nocturne, the charming quartermistress, who claims to have only Shadowheart’s best interests in mind.

But the wealthiest district of Baldur’s Gate has secrets of its own, and it hides temptations far greater than any Shadowheart remembers facing. Torn between the familiar comforts of the dark and the thrill of new desire, she must solve the mystery to prove her devotion… or be cast into the light."
Some fans r/BaldursGate3 had might already noticed there was a Shadowheart book in the works after several international Amazon stores posted a description for the now confirmed book .

But, excitement may be tepid from fans, since feedback for T. Kingfisher's Astarion prequel have been mixed. Fans have called out several retcons to the vampire's backstory, while also lamenting that the book "doesn't do justice to his character" .

While Larian has left Baldur's Gate 3 and the Dungeons & Dragons universe behind to work on brand new games, including Divinity , it lives on. HBO is working on a Baldur’s Gate 3 TV show set after the video game, which not all fans are thrilled about.

Many can’t fathom why anyone would want to continue on from the events of Baldur’s Gate 3 , given its many different endings, variances in world state, and, most importantly, the vastly different outcomes for beloved characters such as Astarion, Karlach, and Shadowheart.

Hasbro also plans for a video game follow-up to Baldur’s Gate 3 , but whether that’s a Baldur’s Gate 4 that continues the story or something entirely different remains to be seen. In the meantime, these books will give fans something to chew on.

items.title: GTA 6 Players Agree That Jason's Stash Needs a Major Tweak
items.summary: GTA 6 players can't help but agree that controlling Jason's stash is harder than it needs to be, and they're a

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/20/gta-6-jasons-stash-1795194400431.png
GTA 6 players can't help but agree that controlling Jason's stash is harder than it needs to be, and they're asking Rockstar Games for a fix.

The newest Grand Theft Auto entry may have launched as the highest-rated video game of all time , but it isn't completely perfect. Leonida is a massive island with details tucked into every Vice City street corner, and early adopters are saying that one of its peskiest issues can be found without leaving Jason's seaside home.

You hardly need to get one hour into GTA 6's story to reach Jason's Stash, a secret collection of valuables tucked under the floorboards in his bedroom. For players, it's good for two things: keeping a box of cherished memories and stowing away piles of cash for safekeeping. The sad part is, doing that second thing is a major pain.

It's a bit hard to explain if you've not played GTA 6, but if you have, you'll know what we're talking about. Depositing and withdrawing money into Jason's stash is finicky, to say the least. Controlling the amount means slowly counting by the individual dollar, and if you hold on the D-pad to input vastly higher or lower amounts of money, the count ramps up by the thousands in what feels like just a few moments.

It's the kind of flaw that couldn't possibly break the bank for a game swimming in ideas that have players thrilled, but when such a noticeable speed bump rears its head so early on, it means just about everyone who touches GTA 6 will encounter it. That's why it should come as no surprise to see so many people mentioning the annoyance online.

"The UI to pick how much money you want to deposit or withdraw from your stash or ATM. It's impossible to not overshoot the amount you are going for," one ResetEra user said . "Give me a simple +100/-100 set of buttons instead please."
"1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 10,000," one Reddit user joked .
"Same," another said , "And man, what a f**king joy it is for this to be my biggest gripe."

It's hard not to laugh at such a minor inconvenience emerging as one of the bigger complaints in a game that has something for everyone. You can do everything from stealing cocaine from crashed boats to double fisting red delicious apples as you talk to your ex, so the fact that one of the only problems everyone can agree on is a small UI flaw stands as a testament to what Rockstar has created.

Still, players have found it to be pretty annoying. So much so, in fact, that some have refused to deal with Jason's Stash at all. Of course, if you've played GTA 6 enough, you'll know that, when you get 'Wasted,' you'll lose the money on your person. Hauling around thousands of dollars and engaging in a little road rage on the way to meet Lucia for a date can and has left players penniless.
"Yeah. I was like f**k this I'm just gonna carry my bankroll," one user admitted ." Died for the first time immediately and lost it all lmao."
"Losing everything on death has pissed me off so bad already," another said . "You clip one driver at a red light, they get road rage and destroy the car and I lose thousands out of my stash."
"OK good, I'm not the only one," another player added . "Honestly the only thing I’m like 'can R* patch this?' I'm like 20..30…$2000 dammit!"

A stash is also inherently the kind of thing players will keep coming back to, meaning more encounters with that same blemish over time, which is why some are taking to online forums to voice their complaints. Rockstar will surely be busy patching other bugs and glitches in the near future, but fans hope Jason's Stash is high on the list for a fix.

items.title: GTA 6 才发布一天，人们就已经向 Take-Two 的老板询问 GTA 7 的情况
items.summary: GTA 6 has finally arrived after more than a decade of waiting, but apparently that's not enough for some peopl

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/19/gtavi-16-1795106399624.jpg

GTA 6 has finally arrived after more than a decade of waiting, but apparently that's not enough for some people. Less than 24 hours after Rockstar's long-awaited sequel launched, Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick is already being asked about GTA 7.
Appearing in an interview with TBPN yesterday, the day GTA 6 launched, Zelnick was congratulated on the game's success before being hit with a question that will haunt him for the decade.
"When do we get GTA 7?" one of the hosts asked, before quickly clarifying that he was joking.
"Once you get through several hundred hours of the most incredible fun you've ever had, ask the question again," Zelnick replied.

Fair enough. After all, GTA 6 has barely been out long enough for players to get properly acquainted with Jason and Lucia, let alone start thinking about what Rockstar might have planned for the next installment. But Zelnick wasn't quite finished being asked about GTA 7.

Later in the interview, during a discussion about AI and how technology could allow developers to create increasingly ambitious games, one of the hosts suggested that GTA 7 could theoretically be a live recreation of the entire world. Zelnick, understandably, couldn't resist pointing out the absurdity of discussing the next GTA game on the very day its predecessor launched.
"Take-Two just went live with GTA 6 November 19th. Wait, let me check my watch. Oh, it's still November 19th. And you're asking a question about GTA 7."
The hosts joked that they were simply moving the goalposts, but Zelnick continued to marvel at the timing.

"My father-in-law had a line about whenever he had many great business achievements and a lot of admirers. And if he ever said anything nice, he'd say, 'Oh, those are yesterday's headlines.' But it's not even yesterday. It's today."
Of course, the GTA 7 questions were firmly tongue-in-cheek, and Zelnick didn't offer any indication of when, or even if, Rockstar might release another mainline Grand Theft Auto game.

Still, given that GTA 5 launched back in 2013, and fans have spent the intervening years desperately waiting for its successor, it's perhaps inevitable that people are already wondering just how long they'll have to wait for GTA 7. For now, though, Zelnick would probably appreciate it if everyone could at least finish GTA 6 first.

items.title: GTA 6 在某些 PS5 上崩溃并出现 CE-108255-1 错误代码
items.summary: After years of waiting, GTA fans can finally play GTA 6 , but some players are encountering a dreaded error co

content.v: After years of waiting, GTA fans can finally play GTA 6 , but some players are encountering a dreaded error code that makes the game crash or otherwise fail.

Users are reporting receiving the CE-108255-1 error code, which players might see when a game crashes mid-session or fails to load entirely. Crashing mid-game in GTA 6 would be particularly frustrating given how saves work .

Sony's official word is that players can try updating their game to fix the issue. If it's really that simple, that would be a welcome result. But people are saying that doesn't always work and are asking Rockstar to put out an official patch.

Reddit user Acrobatic-Promise458 encountered this issue and documented their experience. The person said the game was working normally until they reached a certain point in the story, at which point the game crashes continually. They said Rockstar support directed them to Sony's own support team, but it was no use.
People online ( via Gizmodo ) are theorizing that the crashing issues with GTA 6 on PS5 might be due to the game's intense demands on the hardware, and it could be specifically tied to older PS5s.

Rockstar has yet to officially respond to these reports. Rockstar's official GTA 6 error troubleshooting page isn't much help, as it only links to the support sites for PlayStation and Xbox and offers no specific help . Players can submit a support ticket to Rockstar to get more help with this issue or others.
These issues do not appear to be very widespread, but if you're experiencing the CE-108255-1 error on PS5, that's no consolation to you.
GTA 6 has reportedly sold 25 million copies and earned more than $2 billion in revenue already , and those numbers are only expected to grow higher.

For more, check out GameSpot’s GTA 6 review and our rundown of the five best things to do first. And if you’re eager for news on GTA 7 ? Get comfortable, because Rockstar is not going to announce it anytime soon .

items.title: GTA 6 显示设置说明 - 我们对运动模糊、亮度降低等的建议
items.summary: While we'll have to wait a little while longer for a PC version of GTA 6 that you can tweak to your heart's co

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/20/ultimate-edition-saras-salon-03-1795193756470.jpg

While we'll have to wait a little while longer for a PC version of GTA 6 that you can tweak to your heart's content, there are still some visual dials you can tune to get Vice City looking just a little bit better.

There is a display page in the GTA 6 settings menu that you can get to by pausing the game and going to 'Settings.' Then, hit R1 (PS5) or RB (Xbox) until you get to the 'Display' tab. There are several options available, which are mostly aesthetic, but there are some things you can adjust, like Motion Blur, that can change the way the game feels.

The first couple options are Brightness Calibration and Safe Zone. For the former, adjust the brightness bar until the Rockstar logo is barely visible. I know it's tempting to crank the brightness to make it easier to see things in the environment, but with how much emphasis GTA 6 puts on immersion, it's really just best to follow the instructions here. Plus, I haven't really had any situations where the environment was too dark to see what I'm doing — not yet, at least.

The Safe Zone setting just adjusts the borders of the screen. I'd leave this at its default setting unless there are parts of the game that are getting cropped out of the picture. Then, adjust using the D-pad untill all the white border icons are just visible on the corners of your display.

The next three settings — Player Status Effects Intensity, Hit Effects Intensity, and Awareness Effects Intensity — adjust the way that the screen effect alert you to what's going on with your character. I keep all of these maxed out because I like being able to react as quickly as possible. But if they're distracting for you, you can turn them as low as you'd like, just be warned: It'll probably make the game a little bit harder.

Then, there's motion blur. Full disclousure, I do not like motion blur at all, so I usually turn this down to 1 or 0. Basically what it does is introduce a blurring effect to your surroundings whenever you move the camera or your character quickly. Turn it up if you like it, turn it off if it gives you a headache.

The dismemberment toggle is pretty self-explanatory. Turning it on will show when limbs are taken off with certain types of injuries. Turn it off if it makes you queasy. The blood and gore intensity slider is a similar beast. By default it's set to high (3/3), but you can adjust it to either limit the amount of blood or turn it off altogether.

GTA 6 also lets you change the way that flashbangs affect your screen. You can either set it to bright, which will white-out your screen whenever you get flashbanged, or set it to dark, which will do the opposite. This is a godsend for playing at night, especially if you don't want to wake anyone up with a super bright flash on your TV.

Then there's brightness reduction. This might be the most impactful display setting for GTA 6, as it "applies a filter to the world that softens the output of bright lights without impacting the HUD." And while that might sound appealing for anyone with sensitive eyes, just be warned that it drastically changes the way the game looks. It ends up giving the world a washed out, almost blown out aesthetic that is decidedly less appealing to look at. Make sure it's turned off unless you're specifically looking to reduce the brightness of lights in the game. Luckily, the game will warn you when you toggle it on, and makes you confirm your choice before it actually goes into effect.

Finally there's high contrast shaders. This is actually an awesome accessiblity feature, and lets you assign high contrast shaders to the player, allies, enemies and interactive objects to make it easier to spot everything. GTA 6 is a visually busy game, and if you're visually impaired in any way, this can make the game a lot easier. The setting will turn on all the shaders by default, though you can toggle each of them individually. Players are yellow, allies are blue, enemies are red and interactive objects are gray. You can also change the fill opacity to make it less garish.

items.title: 《纽约时报》的报道记录了英伟达前首席执行官黄仁勋数十年来对员工的斥责：“他说他会把下属的双臂扯下来，然后用它们把那个人的头打死”
items.summary: Huang claims "he couldn’t motivate them simply with money".

content.v: It's been a strange couple of weeks for former Nvidia CEO, Jensen Huang. The once tech leader admitted to an affair, only for multiple affair allegations to surface , and he was then ousted from the company . Now, as he reportedly mounts a comeback, The New York Times has published a report detailing an alleged decades-long philosophy of getting more work out of employees "through humiliation".
Reportedly, Huang told employees that they had become so rich that "he couldn’t motivate them simply with money", so the "only way he could grind more work out of them was through humiliation".

This method has reportedly been Huang's modus operandi for some time, with more than a dozen current and former employees claiming: "He has long used humiliation as a tool, excoriating employees in front of their peers with insults, personal attacks and violent comments, while telling them it was good for them or for the business."

That humiliation allegedly took many forms. One employee reported that Huang "said he would rip both arms off a subordinate and beat the person over the head to death with them. And he told another employee he would rip off the top of their head and 'pee on your brain'."

Two years ago, in a conversation with Stripe's Patrick Collison , Jensen Huang said, "I'd rather torture you into greatness, because I believe in you", and this behaviour appears to be an extension of that philosophy.

Huang has apparently been called out for this behaviour. In the NYT report, Michael Winston, a former senior vice president of human resources, claims he threatened to sue Nvidia in 2005, after allegedly being fired for objecting to Huang's conduct. He says it is “the most verbally abusive, threatening and intimidating behavior” in his career and notes that Huang “thinks he can get away with anything.”
This lawsuit was apparently settled confidentially for more than $1 million, and was not previously public.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/KzRgxseXSQCKskW6G4CjcN-1920-80.jpg

Still, Huang has quite a few supporters at Nvidia too. Reportedly, someone took to the Nvidia internal suggestion box before Huang's ousting to ask Nvidia to consider keeping him after the affair scandal, and this was met with 1,600 comments, the majority of which agreed with the claim. One said: "If you believe in the mission, bring back THE boss."

After this, a public petition titled " Bring Back Jensen " managed to achieve over 200,000 signatures. Huang's role at Nvidia can't be overstated, being the CEO since its founding in 1993. The gaming company turned AI company is worth trillions of dollars, and that no doubt means something to at least some employees who wouldn't be there without it.
Still, I can't say I'd be very happy if my editor told me they'd rip my arms off and beat me to death with them, regardless of how much money they're paying me.

items.title: GameStop 老板呼吁归还实体光盘，就像《侠盗猎车手 6》对数字版大作一样
items.summary: Yes, it's true: this man has no disc.

content.v: GameStop boss Ryan Cohen (last seen attempting to buy eBay ) has called for the return of physical game discs, lamenting the lack of control players have over digital purchases in a chat with Bloomberg held on the eve of Grand Theft Auto 6's release.

In case you missed it, a media meteor impacted yesterday and blasted our landscape free of life. Grand Theft Auto 6 is here and—despite our Ted Litchfield's noble attempts to get you all thinking about Queen's Domain instead (you should play Queen's Domain)—it's all the world can talk about. It's also only available digitally.

"Unquestionably, the decision to move to all digital has hurt consumers, and it’s also hurt GameStop", said Cohen, remarking that players ought to be able to do with their purchased games as they will: "When you buy a game, you should be able to sell it, trade it or lend it to a friend". Cohen did not namecheck GTA 6 specifically, but did say that he had been speaking about this issue with all "the obvious" publishers.

GameStop, of course, makes a tidy chunk of change from resales of games traded in at its stores—a segment of its business that becomes impossible to maintain in a world without physical discs for players to bring in and sell. Publishers oppose trade-ins "because removing a used copy eliminates an alternative to buying new", says Cohen, accusing them of "taking away competition" by restricting sales to digital-only channels.

GTA 6 is a portent of the world to come. Earlier this year, Sony announced that PlayStation would drop physical discs starting in January 2028, and has held firm to that course in the face of a vocal player uproar.

Issues around game ownership have reached the point that politicians are weighing in: last month US lawmaker Richie Torres announced the Power To The Players Act , that would prompt the US Federal Trade Commission to protect players' access to purchased games, even in the case of online-only games that get unplugged.

"When you pay for a game, you should own it", said Torres. "Consumers must have the right to own, the right to play, and the right to transfer the games they buy. A game that can be taken away the moment a company pulls the plug is not a purchase. It is a rental disguised as a sale".

items.title: GTA 6 没有任何 Doja Cat 音乐，她也没有审查她给 Rockstar 的信息
items.summary: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 is out now, and the game features a lot of music from famous real-world artists.

content.v: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 is out now, and the game features a lot of music from famous real-world artists. But Doja Cat is not among them.
She's not happy about that, either.

Doja Cat said online that she is "so f**kin bitter" about that. In follow-up posts, she told Rockstar to "eat my d**k." She said she loves GTA 6, and being left out of the game breaks her heart. Directing her posts at Rockstar in this way, with this language, is unlikely to win her any fans at the studio, so it would be surprising indeed if we see her music get added to the game at any point.

Doja Cat's music is not on any of GTA 6's in-game radio stations, nor do any of her tunes feature on the 34-song GTA 6: The Album, which is out now. The album includes music from Travis Scott, Dua Lipa, Morgan Wallen, Young Thug, Cardi B, Keith Richards, Lana Del Rey, and more.
The in-game radio stations , meanwhile, feature music from Tom Petty, George Strait, Glen Campbell, Bad Bunny, Drake, Lil Wayne, Slayer, Sepultura, System of a Down, and Tool, just to name few.

For more, check out GameSpot’s GTA 6 review and our rundown of the five best things to do first. And if you're eager for news on GTA 7 ? Get comfortable, because Rockstar is not going to announce it anytime soon .

items.title: 想在 GTA 6 中犯罪时保持匿名吗？给自己戴上口罩
items.summary: This special neckwear is helpful in robberies.

content.v: https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/kdDCiNAoqe6nKdiaV6u7RC-1920-80.jpg

The GTA 6 mask neckwear lets you commit crimes with a bit more anonymity. As you might have noticed, cops are a lot more savvy in this new entry, pursuing you based on even your physical appearance. One way to hinder them identifying you is a mask.

The earliest mask you can buy is at Chuck's Tackle & Shot just down the road from Jason's house in Key Lento—if you're struggling to spot it, you can use the map index and navigate down to the Ammu-Nation tab. Any Ammu-Nation store should stock masks for purchase. In this case:
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/FCXhi6z8NyaTB25uRyT6cC-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/pCyjaA5uQpgojxuU5Em9VC-1920-80.jpg

Buy and equip the mask and you're good to go. Jason will wear it on his neck by default but you can cover your face with it in the items menu. If you hold L1 then press R1 to cycle to items, move the stick over the mask, then press up on the D-pad to change the "Wear Style" to 1. Now you're ready for some crime.

items.title: GTA 6 严肃的警察吓唬玩家，让他们真正遵守法律
items.summary: GTA 6's cops are meaner and easier to provoke than ever before, leading many players to obey the law and keep

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/18/gtavi-missions-1794996224895.jpg

Back in the day, the thing we were most looking forward to in any new Grand Theft Auto game was going on a big killing spree for absolutely no reason. I'm sure many of you were waiting to do this in GTA 6 , making the most of all the new details Rockstar added to the long-awaited sequel.

However, now that GTA 6 is finally in our hands, there's a curious phenomenon throughout the player base: no one really wants to commit any crimes. Instead, it seems most of us are spending the early hours of the game going about our day-to-day lives while keeping our heads down. Some of us are even using turn signals when we're driving.
So, why are we playing GTA 6 so differently from the games that came before it? A likely theory is that crime just isn't worth the risk like it once was — the cops really mean business this time.

"2 hours in GTA 6 and I haven’t committed a single crime outside of missions," said X / Twitter user @BearsShowYo . "That new system got me spooked lmao," added @JuJu_Da_Gamer . "The cop system in GTA 6 is crazy lmao I’m genuinely scared to steal a random car," @OvOBrezzzy commented .
MDRRR, pitié j’ai jamais vu ça #GTA6 https://t.co/KnDd7rirJy

They're far from alone in this. "Went into someone's backyard, they threatened to call the police and I genuinely feared for my life man," said @NohanDGreece. "I jumped into the water to get away asap." "Have been a good boy so far, using my own car and minding my business, those MF are brutal," @hissdigg said. "I can’t go home because I’m wanted in my own neighborhood and I don’t have any money to change clothes," added @Adeux_ailes.
Worse yet, the cops have never been easier to set off. Some will even attack you for filming them arresting someone else.
NEW: GTA 6 cops DO NOT like it when you film them stealing money and brutalizing people during stops. https://t.co/Be7LxcHcF6

Because the cops pack so much of a punch this time around, it's completely changing how players interact with the game. "I was texting a friend a few hours into my playthrough that I was annoyed a taxi ride to my (Jason's) house was $162 because I didn't want to walk and she was like, 'Why tf can't you steal a car???'" said @BlueOwlzMedic. "It honestly didn't even occur to me."
"Out here stopping at red lights… cops got me committing no grand theft or auto," added @DallienceRNG .

The biggest change to how the cops work in GTA 6 is that they're a lot harder to shake off . It isn't just a case of outrunning them until they get bored; you've really got to put in the work to avoid getting busted.

First, you flee the scene. That gets them off your case for now, but they will still be hypervigilant in the area you committed the crime. So, you've also got to change vehicles, mix up your appearance, get a new disguise, and make sure you're not hanging out with the person you committed the crime with. Oh, and you better not be walking around while openly carrying a weapon, because that's a quick way to get them on your case as well.

Another change is that there is now a 6-star wanted level in GTA 6 . It's incredibly difficult to achieve, but if you can pull it off, you're in for a hell of a survival mode. And I really do mean survival mode, because it's impossible for the wanted level to decrease once you have six stars.
